item.description:
Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-11-17 | Flagged: Sole-source / non-competitive In plain English (machine-written): The Human Resources Administration plans to award an on-demand staffing contract, through a negotiated acquisition, to supply extra outreach workers for Code Blue and Code Red weather emergencies to find and bring in homeless people; responses are due Nov. 17, 2026.

The New York City Department of Social Services (DSS) has adopted a new citywide approach to the Department of Homeless Services (DHS) response during Code Blue and Code Red weather emergencies. The new zone-based deployment model is designed to provide more consistent and comprehensive outreach coverage across areas with the highest likelihood of unsheltered individuals. Implementation of this model requires additional canvassing capacity beyond current DHS staffing levels. DSS/DHS is seeking to establish an on-demand staffing contract that can provide supplemental staff during emergency weather activations, particularly Code Blue and Red. These staffers would be responsible for going into the field, walking significant distances, engaging with street homeless individuals and encouraging them to come indoors. Staffers would also be assigned to cooling and warming buses to greet homeless individuals by accessing such buses, monitoring them, and offering connections to shelters.
